description: This file defines a Java Swing UI component called RpmCommand, which provides a GUI element (a spinner) for setting RPM values and sending commands to a command queue.

classes.name: RpmCommand
classes.description: A JPanel subclass that provides a GUI interface for setting RPM values with a spinner.

methods.name: RpmCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RPM setting panel with a label and spinner, configuring their layout and behavior.

methods.name: requestRpmChange
methods.description: Static method that sends an RPM change command to the command queue.
